name: butecogames
description: Buteco Games Unleashed - A plataforma de jogos do Buteco dos Devs

scripts.docker:build: docker build -t brunofunnie/butecogames-server:latest -f packages/server/Dockerfile . && docker build -t brunofunnie/butecogames-client:latest -f packages/client/Dockerfile .
scripts.docker:push: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t brunofunnie/butecogames-server:latest -f packages/server/Dockerfile --push . && docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t brunofunnie/butecogames-client:latest -f packages/client/Dockerfile --push .
scripts.docker:push:server: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t brunofunnie/butecogames-server:latest -f packages/server/Dockerfile --push .
scripts.docker:push:client: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t brunofunnie/butecogames-client:latest -f packages/client/Dockerfile --push .
